EmailTemplate.name: Maintenance Troubleshooting / Possible Service Fee Plumbing
EmailTemplate.subject: Maintenance Troubleshooting / Possible Service Fee
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
You have submitted a work order in regard to some PLUMBING issues. We are dispatching a vendor to the property to assess and fix any problem.
Please be sure that you have:
For CLOGGED DRAINS - Tried using MainLine/DrainO to clear any line clogged with hair or grease; and For HOT WATER ISSUES - Checked the breakers to ensure they haven’t tripped into the OFF position (electric water heaters), checked the thermostat and make sure it is on the desired temperature, or checked the pilot light (gas water heaters).
If the vendor comes and the problem is related to a line clogged by grease, hair, or personal items, tripped breakers, a thermostat being set incorrectly, or a pilot light not lit, a service charge will be applied to your account.
Please be expecting a call from the vendor. You likely will not recognize their phone number, so make sure you answer any unknown calls please.
